regime.label: Short-gamma gap to the 1100 flip narrows to a fresh 27.7-point low as the Protection build re-accelerates, 77 DTE
evidence: Cumulative net GEX turns positive only above the 1100 gamma flip; spot at 1072.3 sits 27.7 points below it, the narrowest gap of the 5-day window (down from 34.1 on 07-11 and 44.9 on 07-10), even though the flip itself has held at the 1100-1110 boundary for two straight sessions.

The far 910 put strike added 1,067 contracts (+23%) to 5,711 on 1,074 lots today - the largest single-session OI build of the past week, reversing 07-11's quiet 108-contract (+2.4%) add and confirming the Protection flow is re-accelerating.
P/C OI ratio jumped to a fresh 5-day high of 1.49 (from 1.42), while today's P/C volume ratio spiked to 1.83 (from 1.02), both pointing to active put-side hedging rather than stale resting OI.

Call OI still outweighs put OI by 4,736 contracts in the immediate 1040-1110 band (up from 4,418 on 07-11), a locally dampening tilt anchored by the 1080 call wall (1,887 OI, +11% over 5 sessions) that has kept price capped under the wall even as the broader book stays short gamma below the 1100 flip.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 closed 1072.3, +6.6 points (+0.6%), a third straight up session, and now sits 27.7 points below the 1100 cumulative gamma flip - the narrowest gap of the 5-day window (from 34.1 on 07-11). The far 910 put strike added 1,067 contracts (+23%) to 5,711 on 1,074 lots, the largest single-day OI build of the week, pushing the P/C OI ratio to a fresh high of 1.49 and today's P/C volume ratio to 1.83. ATM IV held at 14.69%, implying a 9.92-point (0.9%) one-sigma daily move, still inside the week's 13.79-15.03% range. Call OI continues to outweigh put OI by 4,736 contracts in the 1040-1110 band, keeping price locally dampened under the persistent 1080 call wall (1,887 OI) even as the wider book stays net short gamma below 1100.
what_changed: Future +6.6 points (+0.6%) to 1072.3, a third straight up session and +31.9 points (+3.1%) off the 1040.4 low set 07-09.
Put OI at the 910 strike +1,067 contracts (+23%) to 5,711 on 1,074-lot volume - the largest single-day build of the week, up from 07-11's quiet +108 (+2.4%).
Gap to the 1100 gamma flip narrowed to 27.7 points from 34.1 the prior session, the tightest of the 5-day window.
Near-put support rolled to 1050 from 1040 the prior session, +149 OI (+19%) to 930; the 1080 call wall held for a fourth day (1,878 -> 1,887 OI, +9).
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has held in the 1040-1050 band all 5 sessions (1040 on 07-07/08/09/10, then 1050 from 07-11 on), while futures swung from 1063.9 (07-07) down to a 1040.4 low (07-09) and back up 3.1% to 1072.3 today - a wide round trip against only 10 points of max-pain drift, confirming the anchor remains structural at 77 DTE. The cumulative gamma flip has held at the 1100-1110 boundary for two straight sessions while spot keeps closing on it through price appreciation rather than flip migration, narrowing the short-gamma gap from roughly 60 points on 07-09 to 44.9 (07-10), 34.1 (07-11) and 27.7 points today - the tightest of the window. Total put OI is up 45.9% from 11,118 (07-07) to 16,216 today, with the 910 tail-put strike alone growing 77.3% (3,220 to 5,711); today's 1,067-contract add is the largest single-session build of the run, reversing 07-11's lull. ATM IV stayed range-bound (13.79-15.03%) with no directional trend, so the put build reads as steady hedging demand, not a fear spike. The 1080 call wall remains the single most stable structural level all week (OI 1,700 -> 1,887, always the largest call strike) and is the level to watch as the short-gamma gap keeps compressing.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050P / 1000P
strategies.rationale: Put OI grew 45.9% over 5 sessions (11,118 -> 16,216) with 77 DTE still on the clock - a Protection-zone insurance build, not a pin - and today's cumulative reading stays net short gamma 27.7 points under the 1100 flip, so a debit spread rides that same hedging flow at defined, capped cost.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid to enter (last-price debit approx 9.8 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 1,960 baht per spread); no further margin exposure.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back above the 1080 call wall without a matching put-OI build would signal the protection thesis is fading, not the rally stalling.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1080C / 1110C
strategies.rationale: The 1080 call wall (1,887 OI, +11% over 5 sessions, 105 lots today) is the nearest live resistance just 0.7% above spot; a confirmed break on rising volume would push spot through the 1100-1110 gamma-flip zone where dealers turn long gamma, so a debit spread captures that momentum at defined risk rather than fading it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid to enter (last-price debit approx 14.1 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 2,820 baht per spread); no further margin exposure.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back below 1050 (today's max pain) invalidates the breakout attempt and favors a fade back toward the pain anchor.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is neutral with a mild bullish tilt while spot closes the gap to the 1100 cumulative gamma flip (27.7 points, the tightest of the 5-day window) and holds above the 1050 max-pain anchor; the call-heavy 1040-1110 band (+4,736 OI tilt) has kept the tape capped under the 1080 call wall for a fourth straight day. A daily close above 1080 on rising call volume would test the 1100-1110 flip/25-delta-call band directly and could flip the book toward net long gamma; a reversal back below 1050, where the near-put wall and max pain now sit together, would risk resuming the wider short-gamma swings seen on 07-09. At 77 DTE, treat directional conviction as low.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here should be read as a signal to execute a position. SET50 index options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so any pull toward max pain (1050) or the 1100 gamma flip is a tendency, not a guarantee, and pinning mechanics here are structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks. This series is 77 days from expiry with OI still building, so directional conviction should stay low, and defined-risk structures still carry their full stated max loss.
